from pathlib import Path
import re

def strip_css_comments(text):
    # Remove /* ... */ including multiline; careful not to break strings (CSS strings rarely have */)
    return re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", text, flags=re.S)

def strip_js_comments(text):
    out = []
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    state = "code"  # code | squote | dquote | template | line_comment | block_comment | regex
    while i < n:
        c = text[i]
        nxt = text[i+1] if i+1 < n else ""

        if state == "code":
            if c == "/" and nxt == "/":
                state = "line_comment"
                i += 2
                continue
            if c == "/" and nxt == "*":
                state = "block_comment"
                i += 2
                continue
            if c == "'":
                state = "squote"
                out.append(c)
                i += 1
                continue
            if c == '"':
                state = "dquote"
                out.append(c)
                i += 1
                continue
            if c == "`":
                state = "template"
                out.append(c)
                i += 1
                continue
            # rough regex detection: after = ( [ , : ! & | ? { } ; or start, or return
            out.append(c)
            i += 1
            continue

        if state == "line_comment":
            if c == "\n":
                state = "code"
                out.append(c)
            i += 1
            continue

        if state == "block_comment":
            if c == "*" and nxt == "/":
                state = "code"
                i += 2
            else:
                i += 1
            continue

        if state == "squote":
            out.append(c)
            if c == "\\" and i+1 < n:
                out.append(text[i+1])
                i += 2
                continue
            if c == "'":
                state = "code"
            i += 1
            continue

        if state == "dquote":
            out.append(c)
            if c == "\\" and i+1 < n:
                out.append(text[i+1])
                i += 2
                continue
            if c == '"':
                state = "code"
            i += 1
            continue

        if state == "template":
            out.append(c)
            if c == "\\" and i+1 < n:
                out.append(text[i+1])
                i += 2
                continue
            if c == "`":
                state = "code"
            i += 1
            continue

    return "".join(out)

def strip_html_comments(text):
    # Remove <!-- ... --> but not conditional IE (none here)
    return re.sub(r"<!--.*?-->", "", text, flags=re.S)

def collapse_blank_lines(text):
    # Collapse 3+ newlines to 2
    text = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", text)
    # Remove trailing whitespace on lines
    text = "\n".join(ln.rstrip() for ln in text.splitlines())
    if not text.endswith("\n"):
        text += "\n"
    return text

files = {
    "docs/assets/document.css": "css",
    "docs/assets/document.js": "js",
    "docs/architecture.html": "html",
}

for fp, kind in files.items():
    p = Path(fp)
    raw = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    before = len(raw)
    if kind == "css":
        out = strip_css_comments(raw)
    elif kind == "js":
        out = strip_js_comments(raw)
    else:
        out = strip_html_comments(raw)
    out = collapse_blank_lines(out)
    p.write_text(out, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"{fp}: {before} -> {len(out)}")
